claim_boundary: Planning lesson only; no Candidate is activated and no behavioral evidence is added.
observations: The closed author-release analysis leaves the healthy-intervention denominator unknown; a prospective control design remains justified but unstarted.

A prior Click trial became non-evaluable because installed distribution metadata was absent, so the next unit makes source and baseline reproducibility an explicit stop gate before any costly semantic arm.
Selecting one bounded gate avoids turning a 48-attempt proposal into a single unevaluable Root step and preserves negative outcomes without convenient reselection.
